hero.name: Bruno Carvalho
hero.title: Android Developer
hero.description: Android Engineer at Itaú Unibanco, focused on performance, observability and architecture for one of the largest mobile banking apps in Latin America — used by tens of millions of people every day.

about.title: About Me
about.description: Android Engineer with 5+ years of experience, currently focused on performance, observability and architecture for the Itaú Unibanco app — used by tens of millions of people every day. To me, good code isn't just code that works: it's code you can measure, understand and continuously improve.

features.title: Mobile Android
features.description: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose day to day, on one of the largest mobile banking apps in Latin America — after 5+ years moving from back-end into this world.

features.title: Architecture
features.description: I design modules, weigh trade-offs, and simplify complexity in large codebases, always thinking about long-term maintainability.

features.title: Collaboration
features.description: I've given an internal talk on Android memory management for Itaú's engineering team, and enjoy hashing out technical decisions as a group.

features.title: Performance & Observability
features.description: I track crash rate, ANRs and latency (p95/p99) for critical flows in production, and turn that data into concrete technical decisions.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.description1: I started in back-end (PHP/Laravel) in 2020 and moved to Android at Itaú Unibanco in 2021, as a Junior IT Engineering Analyst. Today, as a Mid-level Analyst, I'm still on the same team — but now focused on performance, observability and multi-module architecture for the bank's app.
journey.description2: Day to day, that means monitoring crash rate, ANRs and latency (p95/p99) for critical flows in production, and turning that data into concrete technical decisions. I've given an internal talk on Android memory management for Itaú's engineering team, and I'm an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.description: Below are some projects that highlight my work as an Android developer, showcasing my technical skills, creativity and focus on usability and performance.

items.title: Friends Secrets
items.description: Android app for Secret Santa draws with smart gift suggestions, using AI to make the process more fun.

items.title: Paguei!
items.description: Android app to centralize and organize expenses and bills, with an intuitive interface and support for splitting costs.

items.title: Personal Portfolio
items.description: Portfolio website built with Angular to showcase my projects, skills and contact information.

items.title: PhotoBoost
items.description: Node.js script for bulk image processing from templates defined by designers, speeding up the creation of visual content.

items.title: Revise
items.description: Web app for preventive vehicle maintenance. Lets the user register their car's mileage and, based on that, recommends services and parts to check periodically.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Technologies and tools I use day-to-day as an Android developer, delivering robust, efficient solutions aligned with market best practices.

additionalInfo.title: Always Learning
additionalInfo.description: I came from back-end into Android, and I keep shifting focus whenever a more interesting problem shows up — today it's performance and observability, tomorrow it could be something else.

highlights.title: Quality Focus
highlights.description: I measure before I optimize — technical decisions based on production data, not guesswork.

highlights.title: Performance
highlights.description: Focused on crash rate, ANRs and latency for critical flows — what the user actually feels.

highlights.title: Staying Current
highlights.description: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, and always willing to switch stacks when it makes sense for the problem.

softSkills.title: Soft Skills
softSkills.description: Behavioral and interpersonal skills that amplify my technical expertise.

skills.title: Communication
skills.description: Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and objectively.

skills.title: Problem Solving
skills.description: Critical analysis and pursuit of creative solutions.

skills.title: Adaptability
skills.description: Flexibility to adjust to change and new challenges.

skills.title: Time Management
skills.description: Organizing and prioritizing tasks and projects.

skills.title: Leadership
skills.description: Ability to guide teams and make technical decisions.
